request.query:
GOAL: A short note the person keeps open while booking or at the service desk: which service to choose, what to write in a free-text field, what to bring and when they plan to go, all from the facts. Not an email: no request for a reply.

FACTS:
P1: I arrive in Helsinki on 1 December 2026.
P2: I am an EU citizen, moving to Helsinki for work and study.
F1: Opening hours: Police helpline Mon–Fri 8:00–16:15; any police station can be visited regardless of residence
F2: Bring: valid passport or identity card
F3: Bring: passport photograph taken within the last 6 months
F4: How long it takes: 1–2 weeks after the police station visit
P3: I plan to go (Police) on 28 December 2026.

data.subject: Booking note: identity card for a foreigner at the police

sentences.text: Service to choose: Identity card for a foreigner (Police).
I am an EU citizen moving to Helsinki for work and study, and I arrive on 1 December 2026.
I plan to go to the police on 28 December 2026.
Any police station can be visited regardless of residence, and the police helpline is open Mon–Fri 8:00–16:15.
Bring: a valid passport or identity card.
Bring: a passport photograph taken within the last 6 months.
It takes 1–2 weeks after the police station visit.
